title: China-to-Belgium Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: EMC — IEC 62920 and IEC 61000 Evidence for Belgium PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: Belgium PV inverter EMC expectations should be prepared on an IEC/EN basis because NBN is the national standards body and project specifications for grid-connected PV commonly reference IEC-family inverter evidence aligned with the EU EMC Directive 2014/30/EU. The practical EMC package should include IEC 62920 for PV power conversion equipment and applicable IEC 61000-series evidence for emissions, immunity, harmonics, surge, voltage dips, and power quality. For Elia and DSO (Fluvius/ORES/RESA) grid-connected projects, harmonic and conducted-emission evidence should be tied to the actual inverter model, rating, and configuration. Because Belgium uses a 230/400 V, 50 Hz grid, EMC and harmonic results obtained only under China 220/380 V conditions should be reviewed for applicability before submission. Belgium's federal market surveillance authority (FPS Economy) enforces EMC Directive compliance for CE-marked products placed on the Belgian market.
target_standards: IEC 62920 — Photovoltaic power generating systems — EMC requirements and test methods for power conversion equipment
IEC 61000 series — Electromagnetic compatibility test, immunity, harmonic, surge, voltage-dip, and power-quality standards as applicable to the inverter configuration
NBN standards adoption and project specification requirements where applicable
Elia and DSO (Fluvius/ORES/RESA) grid-connection review requirements for power quality and harmonic performance
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter EMC evidence commonly relies on GB/T 37408-2021 and related domestic EMC test reports from CNAS-accredited laboratories. These reports can be useful engineering background but are not automatically equivalent to IEC 62920 or the IEC 61000-series evidence requested by a Belgian project owner, NBN conformity route, CREG review, or Elia/DSO grid-connection process. China test conditions are normally aligned with the China 220/380 V, 50 Hz baseline, while Belgium uses 230/400 V at the same frequency.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CNAS-accredited domestic EMC test reports under China standard scopes
rows.gap: Gap: China-only EMC certificates under GB/T 37408 do not automatically satisfy Belgium IEC/EN-based project expectations or EU EMC Directive 2014/30/EU requirements. Exporters should obtain IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000-series reports for the specific model or family, confirm whether harmonics and conducted-emission results remain valid at 230/400 V, and provide surge, earthing, shielding, and enclosure documentation. Where Elia, DSOs (Fluvius/ORES/RESA), or the project owner specifies harmonic limits or power-quality measurements, test reports should be mapped clause-by-clause to that requirement. A CE Declaration of Conformity referencing the EMC Directive 2014/30/EU is required before the product can be placed on the Belgian market.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — CE marking under EMC Directive 2014/30/EU is required before placing PV inverters on the EU/Belgian market; IEC 62920 and IEC 61000 evidence is effectively mandatory where NBN, Elia, or project-owner documentation calls for it
mandatory_status.cn: GB/T 37408 EMC evidence is a China domestic voluntary or certification-programme baseline and is not a Belgium/EU EMC evidence substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat Belgium PV inverter EMC as an IEC/EN evidence package plus EU EMC Directive conformity, not a China GB/T certificate transfer. Prepare IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000-series reports for the exact inverter model, review harmonic and EMC applicability at Belgium's 230/400 V 50 Hz grid voltage, and confirm Elia, DSO (Fluvius/ORES/RESA), and project-owner EMC requirements before shipment. A CE Declaration of Conformity referencing EMC Directive 2014/30/EU must be issued before EU/Belgian market placement.

rows.requirement: Belgian Elia/DSO Grid-Connection Review — IEC 62116, IEC 61727, and 230/400 V 50 Hz Settings
rows.target_requirement: Grid-connected solar PV inverters in Belgium are subject to Elia (transmission system operator) technical regulations for high-voltage connections and to regional DSO rules for low-voltage and medium-voltage connections: Fluvius (Flanders and Brussels Capital Region) and ORES/RESA (Wallonia). The practical IEC evidence package normally includes IEC 62116 anti-islanding and IEC 61727 utility-interface compliance, with firmware protection thresholds, reconnection delay, voltage windows, and frequency windows validated for Belgium's 230/400 V, 50 Hz low-voltage grid. Belgium uses the same 50 Hz frequency as China, but the nominal voltage differs: Belgium is 230 V single-phase and 400 V three-phase, while China is 220/380 V under GB/T 156. Belgian DSOs may also require commissioning documentation in Dutch (Fluvius) or French (ORES/RESA/BRUGEL) depending on the region.
target_standards: IEC 62116 — Utility-interconnected photovoltaic inverters — Test procedure of islanding prevention measures
IEC 61727 — Photovoltaic systems — Characteristics of the utility interface
Elia technical regulations for connection to the high-voltage grid (C10/11 and related technical codes)
Fluvius grid-connection technical rules (Flanders / Brussels Capital Region)
Belgium low-voltage grid context — 230 V single-phase / 400 V three-phase, 50 Hz
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter grid-connection evidence commonly includes GB/T 19964-2024 for PV power station connection, NB/T 32004 for grid-connected inverter technical specifications, GB/T 37408 for PV grid-connected inverter requirements, and domestic anti-islanding test results. These documents are built around China grid conditions and domestic acceptance procedures. China's low-voltage baseline is 220/380 V at 50 Hz, not Belgium's 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Chinese grid certificates and factory firmware settings do not automatically transfer to Elia, Fluvius, ORES/RESA, or BRUGEL project acceptance in Belgium.
china_standards: GB/T 19964-2024 — 光伏发电站接入电力系统技术规定 (Technical Requirements for Connecting Photovoltaic Power Station to Power System)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
rows.gap: Gap: China GB/T and NB/T grid-connection evidence is not a substitute for Belgian Elia/DSO project acceptance. Exporters should prepare IEC 62116 anti-islanding evidence, IEC 61727 utility-interface evidence, a Belgium-specific settings file, and commissioning records for 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Do not describe Belgium voltage as matching China: only the 50 Hz frequency matches, while nominal voltage differs from China's 220/380 V. For projects connected to Fluvius (Flanders/Brussels) or ORES/RESA (Wallonia), commissioning and project documentation may be required in Dutch or French respectively. Elia C10/11 applies to higher-voltage connections. EU RfG 2016/631 applies above member-state thresholds.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory in practice for grid-connected projects through Elia technical review (high-voltage) and Fluvius/ORES/RESA/BRUGEL DSO project acceptance (low-voltage and medium-voltage); EU RfG 2016/631 is directly binding above member-state thresholds
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese grid-connection evidence satisfies China domestic grid acceptance only and is not a Belgian Elia or DSO approval substitute; China 220/380 V evidence must be revalidated for Belgium 230/400 V

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Chinese GB/T grid-connection documents do not automatically satisfy Belgian Elia or DSO (Fluvius/ORES/RESA) grid-connection review. Prepare IEC 62116 and IEC 61727 evidence, re-parameterise inverter firmware for Belgium's 230/400 V at 50 Hz grid, and document the applicable Elia and regional DSO requirements. Dutch-language documentation is typically required for Fluvius connections; French-language documentation for ORES/RESA connections. Verify current Elia C10/11, Fluvius, ORES/RESA, and CREG project requirements directly before shipment or commissioning.

rows.requirement: IEC 62109-1 / IEC 62109-2 Safety Evidence and Belgium-Specific Requirements for PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: For Belgium solar PV projects, inverter safety documentation should be prepared around IEC 62109-1 and IEC 62109-2 type-test evidence for the exact inverter model or family, in support of CE marking under LVD 2014/35/EU. NBN is the national standards body, CREG oversees the federal energy sector, Elia controls the high-voltage grid interface, and regional DSOs (Fluvius, ORES/RESA, BRUGEL) control the practical grid-connection interface for low-voltage and medium-voltage installations. Project submissions should include accredited IEC safety reports, installation manuals, ratings, nameplate data, protection-device coordination, earthing instructions, and environmental limits. Installation manuals and safety instructions for the Belgian market are commonly required in Dutch and/or French depending on the installation region (Flanders/Brussels or Wallonia).

IEC 62109-2 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 2: Particular requirements for inverters
NBN standards adoption and conformity expectations where applicable
CREG, Elia, Fluvius, ORES/RESA project documentation requirements for grid-connected solar PV equipment

rows.china_equivalent: China safety documentation for PV grid-connected inverters commonly uses GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, domestic CQC or CGC voluntary certification, and CNAS-accredited laboratory reports. These documents are useful for supplier qualification but are not automatically accepted as IEC 62109-1/-2 evidence for Belgium projects or as EU LVD conformity. Chinese safety reports may also be based on China-rated configurations, labels, manuals, surge protection, and 220/380 V assumptions, while Belgium project files must reflect 230/400 V, 50 Hz installation conditions and EU CE conformity framework requirements.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CQC / CGC voluntary certification programmes for China domestic PV inverter safety and performance
rows.gap: Gap: A China-only GB/T 37408 or NB/T 32004 safety file does not automatically satisfy Belgium IEC safety expectations or EU LVD 2014/35/EU requirements. Exporters should provide IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test reports for the supplied model or model family, confirm that labels and manuals match the Belgium configuration (230/400 V, 50 Hz), provide documentation in Dutch and/or French as required by the installation region, document protection coordination and earthing, and confirm surge protection. A CE Declaration of Conformity and technical file under LVD 2014/35/EU must be prepared before the product can be placed on the Belgian market. Any changes to enclosure, terminals, firmware settings, surge protection, or nameplate ratings for Belgium can require updated safety documentation.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — CE marking under LVD 2014/35/EU is required before placing PV inverters on the Belgian/EU market; IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test reports are the standard evidence route for safety conformity; Dutch/French documentation is effectively mandatory for Belgian installers and DSO acceptance
mandatory_status.cn: China GB/T, NB/T, CQC, or CGC safety evidence applies to China domestic or voluntary certification contexts and is not automatically transferable to Belgium EU/CE conformity

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not rely on China GB/T or NB/T inverter safety files alone for Belgium PV projects. Prepare IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test evidence for the exact model, issue an EU Declaration of Conformity under LVD 2014/35/EU, align labels and manuals to Belgium's 230/400 V 50 Hz configuration, and prepare Dutch and/or French documentation as required by the installation region. Confirm current NBN, CREG, Elia, DSO (Fluvius/ORES/RESA), and project-owner safety requirements before shipment.
